events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: November 24th marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: A True Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. A voice, a showman, a legend who continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles Release 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, featuring tracks like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life'.

angles.name: Groundbreaking Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that changed everything, from folk-rock to sitars. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: John Lennon Death Anniversary
events.blurb: December 8th marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles icon, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today. His music and message continue to resonate globally. Imagine that.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947, would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Celebrating a Starman
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of the Starman. David Bowie's influence is as strong as ever. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, born on January 8, 1935, would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His legacy is truly everlasting.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, born on January 9, 1944, turns 83 today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin mastermind continues to inspire generations of guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart, born on January 10, 1945, turns 82 today.

angles.name: Still Rockin'
angles.copy: The one and only Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today! Still got that distinctive raspy voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs from Madness, born in 1961, turns 66 today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house down after all these years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, born in 1956, turns 71 today.

angles.name: 80s Crooner
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the voice behind some of the 80s biggest hits, Paul Young!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton, born on January 19, 1946, turns 81 today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon and a national treasure. We will always love her.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow, born in 1971, turns 56 today.

angles.name: Take That's Main Man
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to the incredible Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, what's your favourite track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, born on January 21, 1950, turns 77 today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our playlists today.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame First Induction
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 24, 1989.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony. Who do you think was in that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972, turns 55 today.

angles.name: Take That's Mark
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still looking good, still making great music.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performance.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins, born in 1951, turns 76 today.

angles.name: Another Day in Paradise
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to global superstar, what's your favourite track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, born in 1960, turns 67 today.

angles.name: Romantic Comedy King
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From Notting Hill to Love Actually, a true British icon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo sensation, he's still bringing SexyBack.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: February 3, 1959, marks 'The Day The Music Died,' when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: A Tragic Day
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died' today. Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper – gone too soon, but never forgotten.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still got the moves, still got the voice.

angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of peace and unity lives on.

angles.name: Remembering The Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston today. Her voice was pure magic and her songs live on forever.

angles.name: A Day For Take That Fans
angles.copy: Remember the day your world changed? Today marks the anniversary of Take That's original split. Thankfully, they're back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68

angles.name: Red Red Wine & Happy Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40! Still bringing those reggae vibes.

angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the incredible Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite track from the Suffolk singer-songwriter?

angles.name: Remembering a Beatle

angles.name: The Voice of The Who
